integrity: An exact analytical proof is provided and checked against standalone finite numerical diagnostics. Numerical checks are not exhaustive proofs. No independently audited priority, novelty, or proof validation is represented.
limitations: Strict dispersive ordering is established only for the power CDF (1-exp(-exp(y)))^a with positive real a. No universal claim for IFR distributions. Giam 2026 full article was inaccessible; possible general transform-order coverage remains an originality risk.
title: Strict dispersive ordering of logarithmic exponential maxima
